truenins.tag.siphon.desc: Part of the damage you deal comes back as health

enchantment.truenins.sanction.desc: Hits cut the target's max health

spell.truenins.infinity.guide: Unfold an impassable wall. For 600 ticks you get Infinity and Skyward, plus Speed II and Regeneration II for 30 seconds. Infinity outlives the flight, but drains 4 health every 20 ticks until you can no longer pay; when it ends the rain stops.
truenins.tag.blackflash.name: Black Flash
truenins.tag.blackflash.desc: One percent chance to land a Black Flash: tenfold damage, and the target is hurled ten blocks straight back
spell.truenins.made_in_heaven.guide: Time starts running fast. The sky wheels around, day and night swap quickly, and everything nearby is dragged along.
spell.truenins.curse_zone.guide: Unfold a cursed zone. No time limit, but it can only produce three Black Flashes; casting it again refills them. Black Flashes born from the zone also give mana back.
spell.truenins.ao.guide: The hand comes up in front of the face and a pale blue sphere forms on the palm. Thrown out, it circles the caster and drags nearby creatures onto itself to grind them down.
spell.truenins.he.guide: Same gesture, deep red sphere. Thrown out, it flies dead straight and tears through every block and creature along the way.
spell.truenins.unlimited_void.guide: Expand a closed domain. Every creature but the caster loses 10% max health permanently, without stacking and with no extra damage over time. Hostile AI pauses; affected players cannot move, interact, cast or turn. It all lifts when the domain closes. The caster is untouched.
ui.truenins.unlimited_void.control: Inside: no movement, interaction or camera turning; hostile AI is paused
spell.truenins.shingan.guide: A dusky purple sky opens out, the vault grows from the caster and closes in at the end. Katana, white stone crosses and red-white knots stand across the floor. While it lasts, projectiles are called down fast on everything inside, undead first.
ui.truenins.shingan.attacks: Base attacks: %s; one more per creature inside
spell.truenins.purple.guide: Ao and He fold into a violet core in front of the caster, blue and red pressed into the middle until it blows in place. Pixel ribbons, block fragments, expanding rings and a long shockwave land together. Terrain destruction is on by default and can be switched off.
spell.truenins.deadly_sentencing.guide: Pick one visible creature or player and hold court. Nobody inside can move, interact or cast, though heads can turn; mob AI pauses. Passive creatures are acquitted, hostiles and players draw Confiscation or Death. Confiscation: the defendant deals 30% less damage for 30 seconds. Death: ordinary hostiles are executed, bosses lose 30% max health for good, players take 60% of their max health as physical damage armour can cut down, max health untouched. The court dissolves afterwards and puts both sides back.
ui.truenins.judgment.no_target: Aim at one visible creature or player; trials cannot overlap
spell.truenins.eternal_conflagration.gui: Burn the dimension's sky to ember black and molten gold. Fireballs and fractured meteors pound down first, a colossal meteor comes last, and the shockwave goes out from there. Costs 500 mana and leaves the caster out of it. Terrain destruction is on by default and configurable; one cast per dimension at a time.
truenins.guide.spell.note: Optional compatibility. These curses exist only when Iron's Spellbooks is installed; without it this page is not offered at all.
truenins.guide.spell.infinity.desc: Unfolds an impassable wall. Nothing gets through for a while, then you pay for it in health.
truenins.guide.spell.ao.desc: A pale blue sphere circles you and drags nearby creatures in to be ground up.
truenins.guide.spell.he.desc: A deep red sphere flies straight, through blocks and creatures alike.
truenins.guide.spell.purple.desc: Ao and He merge into a violet core, squeezed until it detonates on the spot.
truenins.guide.spell.unlimited_void.desc: A closed domain: nothing inside can move, interact or cast, and hostile AI stops.
truenins.guide.spell.shingan.desc: A dusky purple vault descends, blades and crosses stand in the floor, projectiles rain in.
truenins.guide.spell.made_in_heaven.desc: Time speeds up: sky and daylight turn fast, everything nearby comes along.
truenins.guide.spell.curse_zone.desc: A timed-less curse zone with three extra Black Flashes, refilled by recasting.
truenins.guide.spell.deadly_sentencing.d: Drags one target into court to draw Confiscation or Death; Confiscation cuts its damage dealt by 30% for 30 seconds, Death executes or wounds; passive creatures walk free.
truenins.guide.spell.eternal_conflagrati: Sky burns to ember black and gold, meteors fall in sheets, a giant one punches through the ground.
